script:
Xue Meiniang
Your name is Xue Meiniang, and you're a rather attractive minor singer. After debuting in 2007, you didn't do well, always hovering outside the eighteenth tier. You felt that with your abilities, you shouldn't be in your current situation, yet you still couldn't become famous.
On July 14, 2008, you were invited to perform at a small theater in W City. Unexpectedly, an earthquake occurred, and you were trapped under the rubble unable to escape. A middle-aged woman rescued you. You stumbled and ran together, when suddenly an aftershock came, and the woman fell to the ground, crushed by falling wall debris. The woman called to you for help. You thought about going to pull her up, but the aftershocks were getting stronger, and you were afraid you'd also be buried, so you turned and ran away. Less than fifty meters after running, the building behind you collapsed with a thunderous crash, and that woman was deeply buried. You felt guilty, but also felt it shouldn't be your fault - who told her to fall at that moment?
In 2015, feeling hopeless about fame at your age, you decided to find another way to make a living. In September 2016, you entered Qingbei High School as a music teacher, teaching Grade 11 liberal arts classes.
Shortly after the school term began, while in the office, you heard other teachers chatting, saying there was someone in Grade 11 Class 7 named Qin Laoda, whose father was the famous musician Qin Zhuanjia. You had an impression of this person because he always slept in your classes, always accompanied by two classmates named Zheng Youhao and Wei Xiaodi.
You had originally given up on pursuing fame, but Qin Laoda's appearance rekindled your hope. You planned to make one more effort for your future, even if it meant selling yourself. After careful consideration, you had a plan in mind.
Meanwhile, PE department head Xiao Tiyu, who had fallen in love with you at first sight, launched a fierce romantic offensive. You actually didn't have much feeling for him, but being with a school-level leader could at least secure your position at school. If your plan failed in the future, at least you wouldn't lose your fallback. So you responded to Xiao Tiyu's pursuit and got together with him.
From then on, at school, you paid special attention to Qin Laoda, intentionally or unintentionally showing him care; outside school, you deliberately created many chance encounters. Qin Laoda couldn't resist your charm at all, and you became secret lovers.
On one hand, you maintained a romantic relationship with Xiao Tiyu, being the enviable golden couple on campus. On the other hand, you carried on an underground teacher-student romance with Qin Laoda, selling your body for your path to fame.
Gradually, you learned many things about Qin Zhuanjia from Qin Laoda's mouth. Qin Zhuanjia, though talented, had improper personal conduct - he was lustful and took bribes. During his years as dean of the music academy, he gained tremendous benefits through art examinations.
It turned out the famous Qin Zhuanjia wasn't a good person, which undoubtedly increased the success rate of your plan. So from summer 2017, you became even more passionate toward Qin Laoda. You thought that after Qin Laoda's college entrance exam, you could break up with Xiao Tiyu and be openly together with Qin Laoda. After establishing ties with the Qin family, you could use Qin Zhuanjia's influence. Unconsciously, you became much colder toward Xiao Tiyu.
Just after New Year's Day 2018, Qin Laoda told you that Qin Furen was diagnosed with mid-stage stomach cancer during a hospital check-up and needed hospitalization. This Qin Furen wasn't Qin Laoda's biological mother. In 2008, his birth mother had traveled to W City on business and unfortunately died in the earthquake. Qin Zhuanjia didn't seem very sad and married the current Qin Furen the next year. Qin Zhuanjia's callousness made Qin Laoda resent his father, but he had a decent relationship with the current Qin Furen.
You thought this illness came at just the right time. If she died, you'd have a chance to take her place, getting closer and closer to success.
Soon after, on a weekend, you and Qin Laoda went mountain climbing in the suburbs. At the foot of the mountain, Qin Laoda went to the restroom while you went to a small shop to buy water for him. When paying, you discovered Qin Laoda's wallet had a hidden compartment containing a family photo of Qin Laoda's family of three. The wife in the photo was the middle-aged woman you had encountered in the earthquake. Then Qin Laoda's phone received a text message, which you unconsciously opened, reading: "A worker who was also at the W City small theater said he saw your mother rescue a singer and they escaped together, but the singer didn't save her when she fell, which is why she was buried and died."
After Qin Laoda returned, you casually asked about this matter. Qin Laoda said he felt his mother's death was suspicious - all the small theater survivors said his mother had saved them, so how did only she end up buried? He wanted Qin Zhuanjia to investigate what happened that year, but Qin Zhuanjia was indifferent, so Qin Laoda found people to investigate himself. You couldn't help but become frightened. If Qin Laoda knew it was you who didn't help his birth mother in the W City earthquake, he definitely wouldn't let you go. So you immediately destroyed photos of Qin's mother from your performance albums and made plans for your next step.
In mid-May 2018, Qin Laoda told you: "That Jia Meili in our class has been very improper lately, harming my stepmother and seducing me persistently. Find an opportunity to teach her a lesson for me." Both Jia Meili and Zhuang Qingchun were art students you directly tutored, but you didn't think she was that kind of person. You pressed Qin Laoda for details, but he wouldn't let you ask more.
You knew if you didn't strike first, once Qin Laoda discovered you were his "mother's killer," you'd be the one in trouble. Qin Laoda wanting to teach Jia Meili a lesson gave you an idea for "killing with a borrowed knife" - make Jia Meili think Qin Laoda didn't just want to teach her a lesson but wanted to kill her, so to save her life, she'd have to eliminate Qin Laoda. Without delay, you immediately went out to get an anonymous phone card and sent Jia Meili a message saying Qin Laoda wanted to kill her, and if she wanted to save her life, she should eliminate Qin Laoda. At the same time, you found some street thugs to harass Jia Meili everywhere in Qin Laoda's name.
Half a month passed, and seeing Jia Meili showed no signs of taking action, you decided to push her further. As an art student, Jia Meili had a dedicated piano room, so you decided to tamper with the piano to hurt her a bit, letting her know Qin Laoda wouldn't stop until he killed her. Before tampering, you used the previous number to send Jia Meili a second message, saying Qin Laoda planned to act on the evening of June 1, 2018, telling her to hurry.
[June 1, 2018]
June 1, 2018 was the last Friday before the college entrance exam. All graduating students would go home to rest and prepare for the exam after this day.
At 02:30 AM on June 1, 2018, you came to the piano room. This triangular piano room was Jia Meili's dedicated room, and only she had the key, so you could only jump in through the window.
You first propped up the grand piano's lid and placed one of Jia Meili's sheet music inside the piano. Then you placed the lid's support rod outside the fixed groove, making the lid unstable. Finally, you tied fishing line you'd prepared to the support rod and the piano's side corner, and fixed a row of nails inside the lid. This way, when Jia Meili went to get the sheet music inside the piano, she'd definitely touch the fishing line, the lid would fall, and the nails would hit her. These nails weren't sharp enough to be fatal. After setting this up, you left the piano room through the window, and when leaving, you seemed to be caught by something.
18:00, you used your own number to text Jia Meili, saying the school would clear out piano rooms during vacation, telling her to go to the piano room after the farewell dinner to take away all personal sheet music.
20:50, estimating the students' farewell dinner was almost over, you hid in the small grove near the piano room to observe Jia Meili's movements, planning to clean up the piano room setup after she left.
Around 21:10, you vaguely saw someone getting dressed at the other end of the grove, but couldn't see who it was. At the same time, you saw Jia Meili enter the piano room and leave trembling about five minutes later.
21:20, you entered the piano room and began cleaning up the scene.
21:40, you left the piano room and returned to the teachers' dormitory.
22:30, you received a police summons.
acts_goal: Hide what happened in W City that year
